description: Breaking-change diff between two JSON Schemas or OpenAPI documents, and whether cached calls still validate — Compares an old and a new JSON Schema 2020-12 (or two OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 documents) and lists each change with its path, keyword, old and new value, whether it narrows or widens what is accepted, and whether it breaks clients: newly required properties, removed or retyped properties, removed enum values, tightened limits, additionalProperties flips, removed operations, removed or newly required param

after.description: The new schema, or new OpenAPI document. Full JSON Schema 2020-12 (local $ref only).

before.description: The old schema, or old OpenAPI document. Full JSON Schema 2020-12 (local $ref only).

arguments.description: Cached call arguments (JSON schema: validated against the root; OpenAPI: against the operation's JSON request body).

role.description: json-schema only: request (default) or response; OpenAPI compares each side in its own role.

name: schema-compat
